Made by ____ D.S. Hocking ____ Forwarded by ____ Inspector ____ E. Ray

Henri Charles Arthur KÜHNE, Netherlander,
suspected of being concerned in espionage and illicit
traffic, see files D.6209 and D.7992, left Shanghai on
May 12, 1938 aboard the s.s. "Glenogle" bound for Hongkong.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 6209
Date 15 / 12 / 34

SHANGHAI, 15 December 1934.

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge the receipt of your
letter of 13 December 1934, No.D.6209 and to thank you for
the information contained therein.

The idea of posing as a German on board ship no doubt
suggested itself to Kühne on account of his German name.
The incident shows at least that he was not over anxious
to have his identity widely known.

I have written to Mr. Kühne's brother at Amsterdam and
will not fail to inform you in case a reply is received.

I have the honour to be,

Sir,

Your obedient servant,

〔签名〕

Chinese Secretary.

T. P. Givens, Esquire,
Officer i/c Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 2, Special Branch.
REPORT
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File NoB-REGISTRY.
No. D 6209
Date 12 / 12 / 34
Subject (in full) Whereabouts of H.C.A. KUHNE
Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev Forwarded by [Signature] S.I.

（左侧边注：See also D 7142）

With reference to the attached communication dated
October 25, 1934, from the Netherlands Consulate-General
on the subject of Henry Charles Arthur KUHNE, who is reported
missing since October 15, I have to report that enquiries
have failed to elicit any information regarding the present
whereabouts of this individual.
He arrived in Shanghai from Tsingtao on April 22, 1934,
in the s.s. "Hoten Maru." On the passenger list his
age is stated as 30 years, his nationality as "Deutsch"
(German) and his occupation as "Kaufmann" (Merchant). Upon
arrival here he put up at the Foreign Y.M.C.A., Bubbling
Well Road, and gave the following particulars:-
1) Name: Henry C.A. Kuhne.
2) Age: 30
3) Nationality: Netherlands subject.
4) Firm: P. G. Kuhne Ltd., Amsterdam, Holland.
5) Present address: As above.
6) Reference: H. Anita Scholem, Sassoon House.
7) In case of emergency notify: P.G. Kuhne, Esq., 228
Overtoom, Amsterdam.
Kuhne resided at the Foreign Y.M.C.A. until April 30,
when he absconded failing to pay $39.05 for lodging, and it
is not known where he resided since that time.
On October 18, Mr. B. Kasanjoglou residing at the Crystal
Hotel, came to Hongkew Station and reported that Kuhne,
his business associate, had been missing since October 15.
According to Mr. Kasanjoglou, Kuhne left the offices of the
Marathon Cigarette Co., 85 Seward Road, on the morning of
October 15 with the intention of visiting F.J. Flink

（左侧边注：See also No. 8953）

制作人 D.S.I. Prokofiev 转呈人 [签名] S.I.

（左侧边注：另见 D 7142）

关于附上的荷兰总领事馆1934年10月25日
就 Henry Charles Arthur KUHNE 一事发出的公函，据报此人自
10月15日起失踪，经查询未能获得有关
此人目前下落的任何信息。
他于1934年4月22日乘坐“Hoten Maru”号轮船从青岛抵达上海。
在乘客名单上，其年龄列为30岁，国籍为“Deutsch”
（德国人），职业为“Kaufmann”（商人）。抵达
此地后，他入住静安寺路外国青年会，并提供以下详情：-
1) 姓名：Henry C.A. Kuhne。
2) 年龄：30
3) 国籍：荷兰臣民。
4) 公司：P. G. Kuhne Ltd.，荷兰阿姆斯特丹。
5) 现住址：同上。
6) 推荐人：H. Anita Scholem，沙逊大厦。
7) 紧急联系人：P.G. Kuhne 先生，阿姆斯特丹 Overtoom 228号。
Kuhne 一直居住在外国青年会直至4月30日，
当时他因未支付39.05美元住宿费而潜逃，此后
其居住地不明。
10月18日，居住在晶品旅馆的 B. Kasanjoglou 先生
来到虹口捕房报案，称其商业伙伴 Kuhne 自10月15日起
失踪。据 Kasanjoglou 先生称，Kuhne 于10月15日上午离开
西华德路85号马拉松香烟公司的办公室，打算去拜访 F.J. Flink

（左侧边注：另见第 8953 号）

(Manufacturers' Representative), 3 Ezra Road, and since
that time he has not been seen at either office. A
description of the missing man was duly circulated on the
teleprinter and a corresponding note included in the
Shanghai Municipal Police Daily Information Sheet No.1549,
dated October 22, 1934 (copy of extract attached), but so
far without result.
Mr. Kazanjoglou was interviewed by the undersigned,
but was unable to furnish any useful information on the
subject. From information obtained from the firm P. J.
Klink referred to above, it would appear that Kuhne made
a rather attractive business proposition to that firm and
that he was given to understand that, prior to accepting the
proposition in question, the firm would make enquiries
regarding his standing as a businessman. In the light of
information, which is now available regarding Kuhne's past,
it is believed that having no illusions as to result of
the enquiries, he decided to leave Shanghai.
Miss H.A. Scholem, of the United States Department
of Agriculture, Room 113 Sassoon House, stated that she was
only a casual acquaintance of Kuhne and was unable to furnish
any information regarding his business and/or address in
Shanghai and his present whereabouts. She believes that,
while travelling to Nanking about one month ago, she saw
Kuhne, shabbily dressed and unshaven, at one of the railway
stations, but is not certain that her observation was correct.
Places, at which enquiries were made in connection
with the above include the French Police Boarding-house
Section, various hotels, shipping lines, travel agencies,

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.
No. 3379.

SHANGHAI, 25 October 1934.

S. D. REGIST.
6207
26 / 10 / 34

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that the Netherlander
Henri Charles Arthur KÜHNE, holder of passport No.1102, issued
at Soerabaja on 2 October 1933, and evidently born at Amster-
dam on 19 June 1903, appears to have arrived in Shanghai about
two or three months ago, but did not register himself with this
Consulate-General.

From information received from Kobe this person appears
to have been involved in Japan in financial transactions which
caused his arrest by the Japanese Police, his release and
discharge from criminal prosecution being effected only after
some of his friends assisted him with money.

On 20 February 1934 he left Kobe for Tsingtao where he
was supposed to receive hospitality from his friends.

It appears too that during his stay in Java (1927 or 1938
until October 1933) his behaviour has not been entirely above
reproach.

He talks well and seems to make a good impression on per-
sons he meets.

Whilst in Shanghai he entered into business relations
with Mr.Basil Kanzanjoglou of Greek nationality, General Ma-
nager of The Marathon Cigarette Factory, who formerly had his
office at 9 Hankow Road, but who has removed since to 95 Seward
Road. Kühne himself appears to have been living somewhere on
Rte Vallon.

He stated that his father was also in the tobacco business
and

T.P.Givens,Esquire,
Officer i/c Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

上海，1934年10月25日。

S. D. 登记处。
6207
1934年10月26日

先生：

谨此通知您，荷兰人 Henri Charles Arthur KÜHNE，持有
1933年10月2日在泗水签发的第1102号护照，显然于1903年6月19日出生于阿
姆斯特丹，似乎于两三个月前抵达上海，但未向本
总领事馆登记。

从神户收到的信息显示，此人似乎曾在日本卷入
金融交易，导致被日本警察逮捕，仅在
一些朋友资助金钱后才得以释放并撤销刑事起诉。

1934年2月20日，他离开神户前往青岛，据说
在那里受到朋友的款待。

此外，他在爪哇停留期间（1927年或1938年
至1933年10月），其行为并非完全无可指责。

他谈吐良好，似乎给遇到的人留下良好印象。

在上海期间，他与希腊籍人士 Basil Kanzanjoglou 先生建立了业务关系，
后者是马拉松香烟工厂总经理，其办公室原位于
汉口路9号，后迁至西华德路95号。Kühne 本人似乎
居住在瓦隆路某处。

他声称其父亲也从事烟草生意，并且

T.P. Givens 先生，

上海公共租界工部局警务处，
